mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, receiver_name AS receiverName, receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, province, city, district, detail, latitude, longitude, is_default AS isDefault
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_user_address WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM t_user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM t_user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_address (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail, latitude, longitude, is_default, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detail}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{isDefault}, NOW(), NOW())
